sig: [[["A", "Hi Chloe, got a sec? I've got a couple of questions about the new hybrid work policy."], ["B", "Sure, Mark. What do you want to know?"], ["A", "The email said three days a week in the office. Can I choose which days?"], ["B", "Mostly, yes. But everyone has to be in on Tuesdays for team meetings. You pick the other two."], ["A", "OK. And when does it actually start? I thought it was this month."], ["B", "It was supposed to, but the new desk booking system isn't ready yet, so it's been pushed to January 6th."], ["A", "Got it. What if I need to work from home on a Tuesday, say, for a delivery?"], ["B", "Just get your manager's OK at least a day in advance. It's fine once in a while."], ["A", "Makes sense. Is there a document with all of this?"], ["B", "There's an FAQ on the intranet. I'll send you the link after lunch."]], {"A": "M-US", "B": "F-AU"}]
